prompt: An administrator has recently set up an NFS share on a server and wants to ensure that only hosts from the `10.10.10.0/24` subnet can access it. Which of the following entries in the `/etc/exports` file correctly restricts access to this subnet?
explanation: The `/etc/exports` file specifies the directories to be shared by the NFS server and their permissions. To restrict access to a specific subnet, you should include the subnet in CIDR notation followed by the desired permissions.
